Name: Froststar11's Simple Greenhouse
Author: froststar11
Description:
[b][u]To Install:[/u][/b]
Download the file, unzip it into StardewValley/Mods.
Open the config file.
[list]
[*]If you would like the version that has space for 6 trees, you don't need to do anything and can run the game using SMAPI. 
[*]If you want the version WITHOUT the tree spaces, change "true" to "false" in the config file. Then run the game using SMAPI. 
[/list]

Downloads.Description:
*Fixed an error in the content.json file where I forgot commas because I'm an idiot.

To use: Unzip directly into your Mods folder. Edit the config file. Run the game using SMAPI.
